basis: hour flow / same-day mean, congestion_seg_hourly.csv (109,089 segment-hours, all roads/directions, days with >=12 observed hours)
note: equal-mass multipliers; mean normalised to 1.0 so total daily flow is conserved. Used to price road congestion as the arrival-weighted expectation E[f(v*m)] instead of f(v_mean) — Jensen correction for peaked within-day traffic.
